label: isoscalar_dipion_pdg2025
purpose: The kernel option KernelConfig.isoscalar_dipion (2026-10-08): the f0(500) record, the six N* multiplets at the PDG 2025 hadronic decay modes, and the (N, f0(500)) class of the baryonic continuum's direct pool. Diagnosis: _knowledge/evidence/fixed-kernel-residual-mechanisms-2026-10-03.md (the forward charge budget; the isoscalar dipion). The committed catalog folds the PDG N sigma width into N pi (decays.build_soft_resonance_decays, residual_to_n_pi) and carries no f0(500).
fraction_rule: each listed hadronic mode whose daughters are catalog records enters at the midpoint of its PDG range, a mode quoted as an upper limit at half the limit; the most specific sub-modes of N pi pi are used (Delta pi, N rho, N sigma); the fractions of a multiplet are normalized to unity; each mode is split over the charge states by its isospin Clebsch-Gordan share (N pi, N rho, N*pi: 1/3 and 2/3; Delta pi: 1/2, 1/3, 1/6; the isoscalar partners eta, omega, sigma and Lambda K keep the nucleon's charge); the orbital L is the dominant partial wave (PDG), else the lowest allowed by J and parity

f0_500.name: f0(500)
f0_500.pdg: Mass (T-matrix pole sqrt(s)) = (400-550) - i(200-350) MeV; Breit-Wigner mass 400-800 MeV, width 100-800 MeV; decay modes pi pi seen, gamma gamma seen
f0_500.rule: pole_mass: the midpoint of the pole's real part (475 MeV); nominal_width: twice the midpoint of its imaginary part (550 MeV); support from the pi0 pi0 threshold to 1.0 GeV (below the f0(980)); decays pi+ pi- : pi0 pi0 = 2 : 1 (I = 0) in an S-wave; gamma gamma omitted
f0_500.source: https://pdg.lbl.gov/2025/tables/rpp2025-tab-mesons-light.pdf (S. Navas et al. (Particle Data Group), Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024) and 2025 update)
